sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 233360

values.note: Single site $20/day; group site $50/day. $5 extra-vehicle fee if a second vehicle stays at the site over 30 minutes (or use overflow parking). Check-in/check-out noon.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgregor-lake-campground ('Single site: $20 per day', 'Group site: $50 per day', 'Check-in/check-out 12:00 Noon') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233360 (notice: '$5 extra vehicle fee') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-19 to 2026-09-11: single $20, group $50), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgregor-lake-campground ('$20.00 daily fee single site; 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 27 sites including a host site; most average 32 ft. In the recreation.gov catalog 25 single sites take 40 ft and one 30 ft; the group site (a 120 x 140 ft gravel parking area) lists 60 ft. Four tent sites along the lake near the boat ramp.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgregor-lake-campground ('The campground has 27 sites, including one host site ... Most sites offer an average length of 32 feet', 'Four tent sites are located along the lake near the boat ramp') + recreation.gov campsite search for facility 233360 (26 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites: max length 40 ft x25, 30 ft x1; group site 60 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water in peak season (recreation.gov 'Drinking Water (peak season)'; the Forest Service description says 'Vault toilets and drinking water are available', though its amenity box says 'Potable water is not available at this site'). recreation.gov lists garbage service in peak season; the Forest Service asks visitors to pack it out. Boat ramp, dock and beach.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgregor-lake-campground (Facilities text and amenity box, last updated April 30, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233360 ('Vault toilets, garbage service and drinking water are available during the peak season'; amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water (peak season)', 'Boat Ramp', 'Boat Dock'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'

Only the group site is reservable on recreation.gov; 'The campground campsites are not currently on the reservation system' and 'Non-reservable sites are first come-first serve. Saving sites is prohibited.'

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233360 (Facilities text; notices '16 day stay limit', 'Non-reservable sites are first come-first serve'; maxConsecutiveStay 16) + catalog (26 single sites not reservable, group site reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Forest Service (Libby RD, Kootenai NF) campground at the west end of McGregor Lake, 0.2 mi off US-2 about halfway between Libby and Kalispell in the Thompson Chain of Lakes; sites among young pines. Boat ramp, swimming beach, the 2.9-mile McGregor Lake Shoreline Trail. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Libby RD; single sites FCFS, group site reservable): confirmed $20 single / $50 group, 26 public sites, vault toilets, 16-day limit, 50% senior/access discount; max_rig_ft 60 -> 40 (60 is the group parking area; singles take 40); added year-round availability (managed Memorial Day-Labor Day). Potable water: FS page contradicts itself, rec.gov says peak-season water (kept true, noted). Only an unrelated Kootenai flood alert (West Fisher Rd 231, Ross Creek Rd 398). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Website is the recreation.gov page, which covers only the reservable group site; the Forest Service page for the campground is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgregor-lake-campground.
